Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-base.notes: Named in docs/idea.md. Ships its own modelling code, so both the weights and that code are pinned.

BAAI/bge-m3.notes: Named in docs/idea.md. Also the one candidate whose forward pass can emit sparse term weights; ticket 09 screens its dense tower only, so all four encoders face the same BM25 lexical retriever.

BAAI/bge-reranker-base.notes: The smaller screened reranker (ticket 12), at half the parameters, so the screen separates the reranker's quality from its size.

BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3.notes: The larger of the two off-the-shelf rerankers ticket 12 screens. Same family as the bge-m3 encoder, so document and label are scored by models trained on the same multilingual mixture.

Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-de-en.notes: Wrote reference/label_translations.json once (ticket 08). An input to the pipeline rather than a dependency of it.

bert-base-multilingual-cased.notes: The rejected classifier's base model (ticket 14). A results row, kept here so the cutoff covers every number the writeup quotes.

intfloat/multilingual-e5-base.notes: Screening baseline through tickets 04-08. E5's `query:`/`passage:` prefixes are handled by `stages.encoders.PREFIXES`.

intfloat/multilingual-e5-large.notes: The same family at 2x the parameters, so the screen separates the family from the size.
